summary: Petition under Sections 17(3) and 17(4) of the Electricity Act, 2003, for the creation of security interest over all the movable and immovable assets of the Petitioner in favour of Catalyst Trusteeship Limited, Respondent No. 2, for the benefit of the lender, Respondent No. 3. 2. The Petitioner has filed the present Petition for approval for the creation of security interest over the Petitioner’s assets, including all movable and immovable assets, in favour of Respondent No.2, Catalyst Trusteeship Limited (“Security Trustee”) and for the benefit of Respondent No.3, National Bank for Financing Infrastructure and Development (“NaBFID”/ “Lender”) including its successors, transferees, novatees and assigns for a sum of Rs.1503,00,00,000/- (Rupees One Thousand Five Hundred Three Crores and only) with letter of credit facility of Rs. 400 crore. The Petitioner has made the following prayers: _(b) approve the creation of the security interest by the Petitioner by way of hypothecation/ mortgage/ charge/ pledge/ assignment (as applicable), over the Petitioner’s Assets to the extent described in this Petition, to secure the total commitment to the Lenders aggregating to INR 1503,00,00,000/- (Rupees One Thousand Five Hundred Three Crores and only) in favour of Catalyst Trusteeship Limited, Respondent No. 2 for the benefit of the Lender;_ _(c) approve the creation of the security interest by the Petitioner by way of hypothecation/ mortgage/ charge/ pledge/ assignment (as applicable), over the Petitioner’s Assets to the extent described in this Petition, to secure the total commitment to the Lender aggregating to INR 1503,00,00,000/- (Rupees_ One _Thousand Five Hundred Three Crores and only) in favour of Respondent No. 2 for the benefit of the Lender and for its successors, subsequent transferees, novatees, assigns and any refinancing lenders to the Project by way of hypothecation/ assignment/ mortgage (if any);_ _(e) pass any such other relief as the Commission deems fit and appropriate in the facts and circumstances of the case.”_ executed between the Petitioner and the Lender. As per Schedule I of the Facility Agreement, the Lender can bring any new lender to participate in the agreement. 4. The Petitioner has submitted that pursuant to the terms of the Facility Agreement (Clause 3.1), the secured obligations of Petitioner shall be secured by the following security package: _b) rights, title, interest, benefits, claims and demands of the Borrower in, to and under all the Clearances pertaining to the Project;_ _(ii) The Security stipulated in Article 3.1 (a)(i) to (v) shall be created and perfected (including approval of CERC) within 12 (twelve) months from Initial Drawdown Date. The Security stipulated in Article 3.1(a)(vi) and (vii) shall be created upfront and perfected within 30 (thirty) days from Initial Drawdown Date, including filing of Annexure W, as applicable. The Borrower shall within the timelines stipulated herein for perfection of Security, take all actions including (1) obtaining the Clearances and/or no-objection (as applicable) from the Government Authority; (2) finalization of documents and filing CERC petition seeking approval for creation of Security on the Project Assets within 45 (forty five) days of Initial Drawdown, and/or obtaining Clearance and/or no objection (as applicable) from any other Person from whom an approval is required to be obtained (either under contract or under Applicable Laws) for the purpose of creation and perfection of the Security (including assignment of rights in favor of/ for the benefit of the Lenders); (3) making necessary filing with the Government Authority required to be filed under Applicable Laws (including filing form CHG-1 with the relevant Registrar of Companies, subject to the provisions of sub-clause (iv) hereinafter, so long as the same does not have the effect of extending the timeline for perfection beyond timelines provided hereinabove); and (3) paying all Taxes (including stamp duty and registration fees) in order to perfect the Security._ 5. The Petitioner has submitted that, as per Article 15.2.2 of the TSA, the Petitioner is required to create encumbrances over the Project Assets only in accordance with the terms of the TSA and with necessary consents, including compliance with regulatory approvals as required under the applicable law. The financing structure, including the execution of the Facility Agreement and Security Trustee Agreement, contemplates security creation consistent with the TSA framework and requires the Commission’s prior approval before the creation of the charge.
